# Best-Effort Parse Failure Handling

Parse failures are caught and result only in skipped files and warnings rather than halting the extraction/compilation process. This may result in silently missing facts for files that fail to parse.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/extractors/python_analyzer.py` — `knowledge_compiler.extractors.python_analyzer.PythonAnalyzer.analyze`
